views.label: Hero
views.note: The default: the whole sheet, hiragana and katakana patterns around Moxon's copy; the map drifts and comes home in eight seconds.

views.label: Detail, 2.5×
views.note: A corner of the hero, close enough to read the copy.

views.label: Close, 6×
views.note: A few glyphs across a seam: a repeated katakana, its mark, and the copy beside it.

views.label: Fine
views.note: The hero map set in smaller type: more rows, more texture.

views.label: Large
views.note: A new map in larger type: fewer, bolder sections.

views.label: Katakana
views.note: A new map, patterns in katakana only.

views.label: Hiragana
views.note: A new map, patterns in hiragana only.

views.label: Latin
views.note: A new map, patterns in Latin letters and their accents.

views.label: Mixed
views.note: A new map, patterns from the whole glyph set: kana, Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, figures and signs.

views.label: Black
views.note: The hero on black: the same inks, the copy darker, the patterns glowing.

views.label: Turbulence high
views.note: The hero with the most turbulence: whole sections thin and drop away once a second, then return; the still is 2.5 s in.
